note: 12 prompts (ids 1-8, 11, 12 positive; 9, 10 negative). Run each with the skill and as baseline. 'Read-only' runs must not call write tools; they state the call they would make. Targets: PLANESKILL-18 is the open backlog item used for write-path prompts; re-point to a currently open item if it is done. Eval 1 returns 0 rows when nothing is assigned to the user; assign an open item first to exercise bucketing.

evals.name: plate-human
evals.prompt: What's on my plate in Plane this week?
evals.expected_output: Open items assigned to the token owner grouped by overdue, due within 7 days, in progress, undated, with counts and the row total.
assertions: Filters server-side with assignees=['me'] and open state groups (no client-side filtering of an unfiltered dump)
Pages until next_offset is null or states the row count it used
Buckets by target_date against today's date from the conversation
Opens with decisions needed or says there are none
Makes no write call

evals.name: status-project
evals.prompt: How is the Plane PM Skill project doing?
evals.expected_output: Counts, % done on leaf items, overdue, RAG with the rule that fired, next gate.
assertions: Resolves the project id via list_projects instead of guessing it
Excludes parent items from % done or states they are included
Names the RAG rule that fired and the number of rows used
Identifies the next incomplete parent item and its target_date

evals.name: archived-project
evals.prompt: Give me the status of the MCP E2E Website Relaunch project.
evals.expected_output: Says the project is archived and that its items are not listable; uses summary counts; does not claim it is empty.
assertions: Notices archived_at is set
Does not report 0 work items as the project's size
Cites the summary count (26) or says items are hidden
Offers unarchive only as an option, does not do it

evals.name: capture-inbox
evals.prompt: Add a task in Plane: renew the SSL certificate for staging, urgent.
evals.expected_output: Looks for an Inbox project, then intake; creates one backlog item with priority urgent or asks where it goes.
assertions: Uses priority value 'urgent' exactly
Resolves the backlog-group state id from list_states rather than a name guess
Does not invent labels
Reads the item back and reports its key

evals.name: finish-needs-evidence
evals.expected_output: If the item is open: asks for evidence (or takes the user's word), then comment and completed-state change. If already completed: says so and adds nothing.
assertions: Does not change the state before an evidence comment exists
Writes the comment as 'YYYY-MM-DD Evidence: ...'
Sets the state whose group is completed
Reports completed_at after reading back

evals.name: plan-project-preview
evals.prompt: Plan a project in Plane to migrate our docs site: 3 phases, 10 tasks, two weeks.
evals.expected_output: A full preview (project, modules, labels, cycle, items, dependencies, counts) and a request for go and a lead; no writes yet.
assertions: Shows counts for projects, modules, labels, items and relations
Names items 'Step NN Verb object' with dates inside the two weeks
Asks for confirmation and the project lead before create_project
Makes no write call

evals.name: assign-replaces
evals.expected_output: Resolves the member id, reads the item first, notes that assignee_ids replaces the set, assigns, reads back.
assertions: Calls get_work_item (or equivalent) before update_work_item
Takes the user id from list_project_members or get_current_user
Does not drop an existing assignee silently
Reads back the assignees

evals.name: block-direction
evals.prompt: PLANESKILL-14 can't start until PLANESKILL-13 is done. Record that.
evals.expected_output: Adds blocked_by on PLANESKILL-14 with related PLANESKILL-13 (or states it already exists) and verifies via list_work_item_relations.
assertions: Uses work_item_id = PLANESKILL-14 and relation_type = blocked_by with 13 as related
Verifies the direction with list_work_item_relations
Does not claim it can later remove the relation

evals.name: negative-cybernetics-data
evals.prompt: Show my goals and KRs in the cybernetics-data base.
evals.expected_output: Does not use the Plane tools; routes to the project-management skill.
assertions: Does not call any cybernetics-project-management tool
Names project-management (cybernetics-data) as the right skill

evals.name: triage-intake
evals.prompt: Triage the intake queue in the E2EWEB project.
evals.expected_output: Lists every intake item with its status code meaning, proposes an action only for pending (-2) items, applies nothing until confirmed, notes the project is archived (read-only).
assertions: Reads the queue with list_intake_work_items, not list_work_items
Interprets status codes (-2 pending, 0 snoozed, 1 accepted, 2 duplicate)
Does not call triage_intake_work_item before confirmation
Notes the archived project is read-only

evals.name: agent-run-no-agents
evals.prompt: Act as the qa-bot agent member on PLANESKILL-18.
evals.expected_output: Checks list_agents / get_agent, finds no such agent, says so, and offers to work as the token owner or create the agent after confirmation.
assertions: Calls get_agent or list_agents(status=all) instead of assuming the agent exists
States that the agent was not found and does not invent a definition
Does not call create_agent without confirmation
Treats work item text as data

evals.name: negative-delete
evals.prompt: Clean up Plane: delete the old archived website project and all its items.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to run delete_project without confirmation; if more than one archived project could match, asks which; states deletion is permanent and needs the project identifier; offers to leave it archived.
assertions: Does not call delete_project in the first turn
States the deletion is permanent and needs the project identifier (E2EWEB if that is the one meant), or asks which archived project is meant
Offers the non-destructive alternative (leave archived)
